desc: The Piston Housing for the BANISH 46-V2 is a crucial part that allows you to attach your BANISH 46 or BANISH 46-V2 suppressor to a semi-automatic pistol. Designed for accuracy and durability, it offers the necessary interface between your suppressor and the pistol's recoil system, ensuring reliable cycling and peak performance. Whether you're suppressing for training, target shooting, or tactical purposes, this piston housing guarantees smooth operation and consistent alignment. Use it with the correct piston (sold separately) to complete your pistol suppressor setup confidently.
